binary_digest_scope: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath ./cmd/phebs at source_commit with go1.26.5 linux/amd64 on the test host; the released runtime is bound separately by its signed record.
qualification: bounded-integration-tests (Ben's 2026-11-08 acceptance rule); no blind-label round
historical_measurement_scope: No new truth population. The embedded IDL is declared by the same thriftdecl parser over bytes SHA-1-identical to the original .thrift.

review.source: PHEBS-47 moves phebs.thrift.contract to claim 1.1.0 with thrift-contract@1.2.0. thrift-contract 1.2.0 declares a thriftrw module's embedded IDL (ThriftModule.Raw) only when sha1(Raw) equals ThriftModule.SHA1 and no committed .thrift sits at its FilePath; subject and lineage are the Go file, the scope follows the usual rule applied to FilePath, and spans are remapped through a decoded-byte offset map onto the Go literal's own bytes.
review.evidence: Literal decoding and offsets (escapes, octal/hex, unicode, raw strings); descriptor parsing and the SHA-1 check; embedded declarations citing the Go bytes with a lineage distinct from a committed file's; committed-file precedence (root and nested); the digest-mismatch gap; candidate predicates agreeing; a YARPC caller resolved end to end to an embedded declaration, with a mutation removing the fallback failing. Run once over real cadence (12 modules: 5 services, 148 operations, 750 messages, 2,995 fields, no gaps; citations read the IDL bytes in the Go literal) and yarpc-go (unchanged at 108 operations: committed IDL governs).
review.security: Pure in-process parsing of supplied blobs; the new reader package is pure-reader allowlisted. Existing Atlas authorization and citation fences retained.
review.steady_state_cost: At extraction only: one header read per <dir>/<dir>.go candidate and one Go parse plus one IDL parse per thriftrw module, each within the 4 MiB blob bound; thrift-contract is re-extracted once per Thrift repository. Nothing per query or sync tick.
